notes_for_editor: Story is about 220 words. The 1936 photographs show a fire lookout station at the Mercer ranger station, but no source ties that structure to the tower in our record, so the story treats them as context only. The state inventory record (HI26871) is for the ranger station building: it gives a 1939 build year and a 2023 demolition, which sit awkwardly with the 1936 photographs; that conflict is unresolved and the story says so. The Forest Service Chequamegon-Nicolet fire lookout PDF (fs.usda.gov/Internet/FSE_DOCUMENTS/stelprd3843401.pdf) returned HTTP 504 to fetch_text and WebFetch; retry it before publishing. Do not treat the Mercer station and the lookout tower as the same place without a source.
